title: Radon Seasonal Rise by Basement Zone
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radon:reading
| bin _time span=30d
| stats avg(radon_bqm3) as radon_bqm3 by zone _time
| eventstats avg(radon_bqm3) as baseline_radon_bqm3 by zone
| where baseline_radon_bqm3>0 AND radon_bqm3>baseline_radon_bqm3*1.3
| sort - radon_bqm3
description: Uses Radon monitor telemetry telemetry to monitor seasonal radon movement by monitored zone in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for periods where basement exposure is trending upward, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Radon monitor telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It flags seasonal radon movement by monitored zone so you can spot periods where basement exposure is trending upward before it becomes annoying.
